parameters.help_en: The ID of the external application that was created by another Alibaba Cloud account and can be installed by the current account. The application IDs returned by `ListApplications` for the current account are not applicable. `ListExternalApplications` and `ListApplicationProvisionInfos` only query installed records and cannot discover external application IDs that have not been installed
parameters.help_zh: 其他阿里云账号创建且当前账号可安装的外部应用 ID。当前账号 `ListApplications` 返回的本账号应用 ID 不适用；`ListExternalApplications` 和 `ListApplicationProvisionInfos` 仅查询已安装记录，不能发现尚未安装的外部应用 ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
The permission scopes granted to the application. You can specify multiple scopes separated by semicolons (;).


For supported permission scopes, refer to "OAuth Scopes" in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93693.html
parameters.help_zh:
授予该应用的权限范围信息，可填写多个范围，以分号（；）分隔。


支持的权限范围可以参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93693.html中的“OAuth范围”
parameters.name: scopes
